interval_semantics.partition: Six adjacent integer-clock intervals sum exactly to full root. Medians of columns need not sum to median root.
interval_semantics.event_clock: _record timestamps before its deepcopy; event-to-event spans include prior record copying and intervening work, not isolated stage functions.
interval_semantics.exclusive: Recorded advance, refresh, and RPC-attempt intervals verified disjoint; prefinal remainder is not attributed to a function.
interval_semantics.query: Actual query envelopes are nested inside refresh and MUST NOT be added to refresh; refresh remainder includes ACK comparison, strict_same, copies, trace bookkeeping and retry dispatch with no finer clock.
interval_semantics.advance: Starts after argument snapshot; includes native call and response deepcopy. Not isolated native computation.
interval_semantics.finalization: Build-to-first-encode includes runtime proof/C-or-fallback normalize/first encode. Tail includes strict parse/reencode, hash, ledger encode, append/return. No exact split inside either interval.
interval_semantics.payload: Byte sizes/counts are structure proxies, not time or C-direct-support evidence.

C_provider.scope: Cold provider setup/identity close belong to full campaign; root publication remains fully timed.

cold.scope: Cold setup, 3 full file checks, native branch setup, whole40 continuation, export and saved audit remain separately charged; none is amortized out of full campaign.

GC: Default process GC remains enabled; no sample-local cycle reclamation claim.
